div.div:
Failure-handling invariant
A turn is never lost — any failure (spawn, timeout, unverified write, unparsed outcome) retains the batch for retry; turns are pruned only after verified outcomes (pruneConsumed over the reported seq set).

div.div: Refactor seam (pre-M3): the JEV decision-gate bootstrap (readDecisionsConfig → provider = bridge | RulesProvider) plus the decideWithFallback call sites are generic wiring shared with retrieval-hook and the coming profile-hook — an extraction candidate for lib/decision-gate.ts. Gate polarity (both fail-open), thresholds, verdict predicates and the ledgers stay hook-local.
